annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023 on general product safety
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023 on general product safety
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 135/1
annotation.summary_en: EU General Product Safety Regulation replacing Directive 2001/95/EC. It sets a general safety requirement for consumer products, obligations for manufacturers, importers and online marketplaces, recalls, and the Safety Gate alert system. It explicitly considers cybersecurity, software updates, and evolving, learning functionalities of connected products.
key_provisions_or_claims: Economic operators may place only safe consumer products on the market (Art. 5).
Safety assessment must consider cybersecurity features and evolving, learning and predictive functionalities (Art. 6).
Manufacturers must perform internal risk analysis and keep technical documentation for 10 years.
Online marketplaces have product-safety due diligence and takedown obligations.
Safety Gate rapid alert system and mandatory recall notices and remedies for consumers.
